# 1.27.1 — a maximized window stays on the screen again

A small fix right after 1.27.0.

Settings, keys and conversations from earlier versions are read as they are.

## What was wrong

In 1.27.0 the window became an ordinary application window instead of a tool window, which
brought back its taskbar button and its place in Alt+Tab. As a side effect, a **maximized**
window no longer fit the screen: its content spread past the screen edges and under the taskbar,
so the outermost parts of the interface were cut off.

Windows maximizes ordinary windows by different rules than tool windows. The earlier fix only
fitted the window's rectangle to the screen, and for an ordinary window that was no longer
enough.

## What changed

While the window is maximized, the area where the interface is drawn is now limited to the usable
part of the screen — the screen minus the taskbar — wherever Windows places the window frame.
The window is still an ordinary application window: the taskbar button, Alt+Tab and minimizing
work as in 1.27.0.

## File

`Amarin-Admin-AI-v1.27.1-win-x64.exe` — a single file, nothing to unpack.
